claims.quote: GRIN2B gene, which encodes the GluN2B subunit of NMDARs,
Specifically, mutations V15M and V618G in the GRIN2B gene, which encodes the GluN2B subunit of NMDARs, are implicated in the pathogenesis of GRIN2B-related neurodevelopmental disorders.

Taken together, our results demonstrate that mutation V618G specifically disrupts NMDAR-BK complex formation, impairing functional coupling, in spite of robust individual channel expression in the membrane.
